implementation.companions: gpui/accessibility.go — the type-asserted element companions (A11yCompanion for role/label/description/value/hidden/author-id/focus binding, A11ySynthetic for synthetic children from prepaint state, A11yActions for per-frame action listeners built at paint), honoring the placeholder interfaces already declared in element.go (A11yRole/A11yHidden/A11yProperties). The generic Accessibility(elem) wrapper drives the tree from the REAL element phases: node push at prepaint with committed-layout bounds, synthetic children after child prepaint, focus/action registration at paint.
implementation.identity: Node-ID determinism: FNV-1a-64 over a canonical kind-tagged encoding of the GlobalElementID path (root fixed at 0; synthetic ids hash parent-id+key like a11y.rs synthetic_node_id); ids are tree-local per window; duplicates dropped and recorded on the snapshot. Node identity generations: assigned at insertion, retired at removal; reinserted ids keep the same node id but a FRESH generation, so stale tokens can never target replacements.
implementation.snapshots: PublishWindowA11y finalizes the frame build into a value-copied immutable A11ySnapshot (independent of mutable app state) with repair semantics (focus falls back to root, dangling child refs stripped) and Trace() for fixture comparison. Activation returns a minimal root immediately with a refresh request (the reference pattern); CloseWindowA11y bumps the generation and drops state.
implementation.actions: Generation-checked foreground action routing: A11yToken (window identity + window generation + node + node generation), ResolveA11yToken, DispatchA11yAction validating and delivering inside one App.Update through the existing entity/window/focus machinery; listener-first with built-in Focus/Blur fallbacks; typed errors (ErrA11yWindowGone, ErrA11yStaleGeneration, ErrA11yNodeRemoved, ErrA11yNoHandler).
